intro.label: DECISION BRIEF
intro.title: Turn researched material into a deck people can navigate
intro.subtitle: Structured evidence, explicit recommendations, and a next action
intro.summary: A synthetic example included to prove the public package works without private content.

methodology.label: METHOD
methodology.title: Make evidence, judgment, and action distinct
body: Separate what the source proves from what the operator recommends.
Keep every slide within a visible content budget so presenter mode remains readable.

items.title: A sample operating choice
items.headline: Evidence is only useful when it resolves to a decision
items.thesis: A presentation should tell the audience what is known, what is inferred, and what happens next.
items.whyBody: The deck format is designed for operating reviews where the audience needs to inspect evidence without losing the recommendation. This sample uses synthetic content and public example links only.
items.takeaway: Choose one real briefing, apply a brand profile, and validate the production build.

verdict.fit: Teams turning research into operating decisions
verdict.whyNow: A validated deck is easier to share and review than an unstructured document.
verdict.nextStep: Replace this sample with one source-backed briefing.

highlights.title: Brand profiles
highlights.body: Resolve colors, typography, and wordmark before the renderer build.

highlights.title: Content budgets
highlights.body: Validate the report before trusting the visual result.

tabs.label: SOURCE
tabs.title: Read the source before adopting
tabs.body: The repository is the record for current compatibility, releases, and known issues. Treat marketing claims as secondary.

closing.label: NEXT
closing.title: Build one real deck
body: Choose a preset or supply a custom brand profile, then run validation and build.
